Environment effects

Source: R/e_eff.R
bys_ls_env_effects.Rd

bys_ls_env_effects() computes the environment main effects, the deviations of the environment means from the grand mean.

Usage

bys_ls_env_effects(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
bys_ls_env_effects(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

Arguments

.data

a data frame with one row per plot.

.y, .gen, .env

the columns of the response, genotypes and environments: bare names, strings or vectors.

Value

An \(E \times 1\) matrix with column EEffs (row names: environments).

Details

$$\hat{\delta}_j = \bar{y}_{\cdot j} - \bar{y}, \qquad \bar{y}_{\cdot j} = \frac{1}{G}\sum_i \bar{y}_{ij}.$$

References

Crossa, J., Perez-Elizalde, S., Jarquin, D., Cotes, J. M., Viele, K., Liu, G. and Cornelius, P. L. (2011). Bayesian estimation of the additive main effects and multiplicative interaction model. \emphCrop Science, \strong51(4), 1458–1469. \doi10.2135/cropsci2010.06.0343

See also

bys_ls_gen_effects, bys_ls_ge_effects

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(cultivo2009)
bys_ls_env_effects(
    .data = cultivo2009
  , .y    = y
  , .gen  = entry
  , .env  = site
  )
